label: Each of the four local interfaces can be omitted while the other three hold on the same Nat/Option…
paraphrase: Each of the four local interfaces can be omitted while the other three hold on the same Nat/Option Nat carrier and the complete Grim Reaper action law fails. The omitted interfaces are index admissibility, positive trigger, emission and forwarding respectively. These are formal assignments, not metaphysical realizations.
